title: ntopng Flow Summary Daily Event Volume
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ntopng:flow
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(host_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many ntopng flow summary events land each day and how many distinct host values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest ntopng flow summary records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct host values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It combines how much ntopng flow summary activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
